P.name: Rising Spell Force
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Ezreal''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Rising Spell Force'' for each enemy hit by his {{tip|abilities}}, lasting for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits, and stacking up to 5 times.
P.description2: {{sbc|Rising Spell Force:}} For each stack, '''Ezreal''' gains {{sti|as|{{as|10% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, up to a maximum of {{as|50%|attack speed}}.

Q.name: Mystic Shot
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ezreal''' fires a bolt of energy in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit, applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects and triggering {{tip|on-attack}} effects.
Q.description2: If ''Mystic Shot'' successfully hits an enemy, the {{sti|'''current''' cooldowns}} of '''Ezreal's''' abilities, including ''Mystic Shot's'', are reduced by {{fd|1.5}} seconds.

W.name: Essence Flux
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ezreal''' fires an orb in the target direction that marks the first enemy {{tip|champion}}, epic {{tip|monster}}, or {{tip|structure}} hit for 4 seconds.
W.description2: His next {{tip|basic attack}}<!--on-hit? on-damage?--> or {{tip|ability}} against the target detonates the mark to deal them {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.
W.description3: If the mark was detonated with an ability, '''Ezreal''' restores {{sti|mana|{{as|60 mana}}}} plus the {{as|mana cost}} of that ability.

E.name: Arcane Shift
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ezreal''' {{tip|blinks}} from his current location to up to 475 units towards the target location, then fires a homing bolt towards the nearest enemy that deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|standard sight|reveals}} them for 1 second.
E.description2: ''Arcane Shift'' prioritizes firing at the nearest enemy marked by ''{{ai|Essence Flux|Ezreal}}''.
E.description3: ''The target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be hit by this ability.''

R.name: Trueshot Barrage
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ezreal''' fires a powerful arc of energy in the target direction that briefly grants {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings and deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
